status_note: active, pre-1.0, single author, heavily agent-authored (every file carries 'W1 PR-1 byte-identical to legacy monolith' style commentary); multi-tenant SaaS scaffolding (Supabase auth/RLS, Stripe, Upstash) is more complete than the generation core
core_problem: BYOK/local-LLM website generator: streams a whole HTML site or a Vite+React project as marker-delimited text from Ollama or OpenRouter, parses it into files, repairs the scaffold, previews in a sandboxed iframe or Sandpack, supports delta edits and one-click Vercel deploy.
architecture: Next.js 16 + React 19 + Zustand stores; Supabase Postgres with users, projects, generations (parent_generation_id lineage), project_files per generation, messages, usage_events, api_key_health, plus RLS and AES-256-GCM encrypted stored keys; Stripe subscriptions and metered premium model SKUs; Upstash sliding-window rate limits. lib/llm.ts is a provider-agnostic streaming helper (Ollama NDJSON vs OpenRouter SSE, browser-direct BYOK or the authenticated /api/openrouter proxy). components/Builder.tsx (about 1300 lines) is the orchestrator: buildSystemPrompt (HTML) or buildReactSystemPrompt (React) → stream → lib/generation/parser.ts (HTML markers '<!-- FILE: x -->', '// FILE:', '/* FILE: */'; with no markers it sniffs doctype/function/braces to guess index.html vs script.js vs styles.css; trimToHtmlBounds strips prose outside <!doctype..</html>) or lib/generation/project-parser.ts (line-based '===AIWP:FILE path="..."===' / '===AIWP:END===' / '===AIWP:DELETE path===' with sanitizeProjectPath rejecting absolute paths, '..', backslashes, >200 chars, non [A-Za-z0-9._-/+@]) → lib/generation/react-scaffold.ts ensureReactScaffold/normalizeTailwindSetup (inject pinned package.json, vite.config.js, index.html; delete tailwind/postcss config; strip @tailwind directives; force cdn.tailwindcss.com) → lib/generation/import-validator.ts findForbiddenImports (regex scan of import/require/dynamic import against ALLOWED_PACKAGES; detection only, posts a chat warning) → lib/generation/slot-renumber.ts (rewrites every data-aiwp-slot to a site-wide sequential number) → silent second LLM call with IMAGE_PASS_PROMPT asking for an Unsplash URL per slot alt text → applyImageUrls. Delta edits: modify prompt returns changed files only, mergeProjectFiles keeps the rest; scoped-modify prompt edits exactly one file; plan-mode prompt is a read-only turn that must not claim changes and emits a ```aiwp-plan checklist. Preview: HTML via srcDoc iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" (no same-origin) with external <link>/<script src> stripped and lib/preview/slot-badges.ts injecting a numbered overlay per data-aiwp-slot; React via Sandpack. lib/prompts/templates.ts holds 31 long-form prompt templates with named fictional businesses and explicit 'avoid centered-heading-plus-3-card-grid; use asymmetric split, bleed image, horizontal strip, bento, masonry, diagonal divider, oversized pull-quote' instructions. Repo root also contains tattoo-parlor-builder-prompt.md (a hand-written design anti-pattern list and {{PLACEHOLDER: ...}} convention) and wedding-intake.md (client intake questionnaire).
core_innovation: A numbered image-slot contract (data-aiwp-slot) that survives regeneration, is renumbered deterministically, is visualised as badges in the preview, and lets a user say 'put my logo in spot 3'; everything else is a conventional stream-parse-repair loop.
strengths: Deterministic post-parse canonicalisation: normalizeTailwindSetup/ensureReactScaffold overwrite boilerplate the model should never own (package.json, vite.config, index.html), delete config files it was told not to emit, and strip @tailwind directives; this is 'never trust the model for scaffolding' done in code.
sanitizeProjectPath is a small, correct path-traversal guard for model-emitted file paths (rejects absolute, '..', backslashes, empty segments, long paths, unusual characters).
Import whitelist scan (import/require/dynamic import regexes, scoped-package aware, config files exempt) catches the most common React-preview failure before the bundler does.

Image-slot contract: data-aiwp-slot attributes, client-side renumbering to site-wide uniqueness, overlay badges injected into the preview, and edit prompts that address slots by number; a clean addressing scheme for owner-provided assets.
Delta-edit semantics: AIWP:DELETE markers plus mergeProjectFiles, and a scoped single-file edit prompt that sends only the target file plus a path listing.
Plan mode is an explicit read-only turn ('you are NOT generating... Do NOT claim to have changed anything') with a fenced aiwp-plan checklist; separates discussion from mutation.
srcDoc iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts" only (no allow-same-origin) and stripping of external stylesheet/script links is the correct sandbox posture for untrusted generated HTML.

tattoo-parlor-builder-prompt.md contains a concrete, human-authored anti-pattern list (multi-hue gradient bleed, centered hero with gradient blob, pill buttons by default, Inter/Poppins/Roboto as display font, emoji icons, three identical icon cards, stock 'smiling person at laptop', pastel drop shadows on every card) and a {{PLACEHOLDER: description}} convention for business facts.
Generation lineage in Postgres (generations.parent_generation_id, project_files per generation, usage_events) is a sensible telemetry substrate.
weaknesses: FSL-1.1 license: any use in a competing website-generation product is prohibited; only clean-room reimplementation of ideas is possible.

System prompts are pure aspirational slop prompting: 'elite web developer with 15+ years', 'Fortune 500 client with a $50,000 budget', 'look like it cost $10,000', 'glassmorphism, gradients, or modern design trends', 'Always add 2-3 features beyond what was explicitly requested', 'Generate realistic data, names, descriptions' (mandated fabrication of facts and testimonials).

The React prompt pins and actively pushes a heavy client stack ('USE IT' for framer-motion, react-query, zustand, react-hook-form, zod, dnd-kit, recharts, react-markdown) into marketing sites, uses HashRouter, and ships Tailwind Play CDN in production output; incompatible with a 180 kB JS budget and with Lighthouse budgets.

Image pass asks the model to invent 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-[ID]' URLs from alt text; ids are hallucinated, so the pass swaps working placehold.co boxes for broken images, and it is a licensing/provenance hole.
Validation is warn-only: forbidden imports produce a chat message but the files are still saved and previewed; there is no gate.

Output contract is raw text with comment/marker delimiters; the no-marker fallback guesses file type by substring sniffing; nothing is typed or schema-validated; truncation is undetectable except via the missing closing marker.
The parser accepts the model's own claims about structure (FILE markers) with no HTML parse, no a11y, no performance, no placeholder scan.

Design quality lives in prose templates ('avoid centered-heading-plus-3-card-grid', 'named business Wavelength') rather than in code; the templates admit that phrasing changes alter parser success rates, i.e. the whole pipeline is prompt-fragile.

1300-line client component orchestrates generation, billing, integrations and image passes; temperature is user-tunable; hosted quota logic is bypassable by the 'silent: true' flag semantics being client-supplied.
One star, single author, agent-written commentary about byte-identical legacy templates; no tests (acknowledged 'unit-test gap').
patterns_to_steal: ScaffoldCanonicalizer (normalizeTailwindSetup/ensureReactScaffold) → assembly: after the model's selections are applied, deterministically overwrite every non-selectable artifact (layout shell, head, config, fonts) from the design system; never accept model-emitted boilerplate.

sanitizeProjectPath → fact_registry / assets ingestion: any model- or owner-provided path (asset filename, slug, route) passes the same allowlist regex and traversal check before touching object storage.
Import/host allowlist regex scan → anti_slop tier-1 and qa_gate: ban any <script src>, <link href>, import specifier or image host outside the pinned allowlist; unlike here, make it a hard failure.

data-aiwp-slot numbered asset slots with deterministic renumbering and preview badges → visual_editor (post-V1) for 'replace photo in slot N', and gap_report: enumerate unfilled slots per selected arrangement to tell the owner exactly which photos would unlock better variants.
AIWP:DELETE + mergeProjectFiles delta semantics → visual_editor / agent_orchestration: edits are patches against a known snapshot, never whole regenerations.
Plan-mode read-only turn contract → agent_orchestration: a 'discuss' turn type that is structurally unable to mutate SiteDefinition and must not claim it did.
tattoo-parlor anti-pattern list and {{PLACEHOLDER: ...}} convention → anti_slop tier-1 ban list seed and qa_gate placeholder scan (grep for {{PLACEHOLDER, TODO, Lorem, 'Company Name').

templates.ts named alternate compositions (asymmetric split, bleed image, horizontally scrollable strip, bento with mismatched cells, masonry, diagonal divider, oversized pull-quote) → section library arrangement vocabulary and signature_move naming, authored as arrangements rather than prose.
patterns_to_avoid: Aspirational and monetary-quality prompting ('$50,000 budget', 'cost $10,000 to build', 'visually stunning') → already rejected; produces the exact generic output the templates then try to talk the model out of.

'Add 2-3 features beyond what was asked' and 'generate realistic data, names, descriptions' → fabricates claims, testimonials and stats; every claim in our sites must come from FactRegistry with provenance.
LLM image-resolution pass inventing Unsplash ids → broken images and unknown licensing; asset_constraints require real, owned or licensed photos with provenance.
Warn-only validation → a gate that does not block is telemetry, not a gate; our tier-1 checks must fail the build.
Marker-delimited raw text as the model output contract → cannot be Zod-validated, truncation-detected, or diffed; SiteDefinition typed JSON stays the contract.
Pushing a heavy client dependency stack and Tailwind Play CDN into generated sites → violates JS budget, motion budget and Lighthouse CI budgets.
User-tunable temperature and client-driven 'silent' quota flags → non-reproducible outputs and trust-boundary bugs; generation parameters are pipeline constants recorded in the Decision Manifest.
Any direct code reuse → FSL-1.1 prohibits competing use; clean-room only.
reusable_patterns: ScaffoldCanonicalizer: after parsing model output, deterministically replace all boilerplate/config artifacts with pinned versions and delete artifacts the model was forbidden to emit.
PathSanitizer: allowlist regex plus traversal and length checks for any externally supplied file path before it reaches storage or a bundler.
NumberedAssetSlots: stable, deterministically renumbered slot ids on every image element, visualised in preview and addressable in edit commands.
ImportHostAllowlist: regex scan of imports, script/link tags and image hosts against a pinned allowlist, ideally as a hard gate.
DeltaEditMerge: model returns only changed files plus explicit delete markers; a pure merge function applies them to the last snapshot.
ReadOnlyPlanTurn: a conversation mode that structurally cannot mutate state and is instructed never to claim it did.
adoption_strategy: Adapt (patterns only, clean-room). The codebase itself is off-limits under FSL-1.1 and its generation core is prompt-driven slop with warn-only checks, so nothing is adopted. Reimplement four small mechanisms in our TypeScript: a scaffold canonicalizer in assembly, a path sanitizer for asset ingestion, a hard import/host allowlist in the tier-1 gate, and numbered asset slots feeding the Gap Report now and the visual editor post-V1. Copy the human-written anti-pattern list from tattoo-parlor-builder-prompt.md into the tier-1 ban seed and adopt a {{PLACEHOLDER}} scan in launch QA. Ignore the prompts, the image pass, the React dependency stack and the Sandpack/CDN preview path.
